authority: Own planning envelope and own board evidence only. Proposed capability/schema details remain unapproved. No UI/product/tests changed.
baseline: Editor/Viewer and architecture/UI binding remain within M03 responsibility
C+B and DX1-DX7 approval for M02 does not approve M03 runtime capabilities or media decoder matrix
Preview is communication/interaction evidence, never product acceptance or code execution authorization

observations: HOST DesignMeta includes title/updatedAt/targetStack; DesignDoc includes nodes/selection/product_pass. JS default meta has guides. This field mismatch is a roundtrip risk requiring a fixture, not runtime proof of an observed loss.

build_preview_html validates DesignDoc and renders node buttons with a selection-summary click handler. It escapes display values and uses textContent for the side panel. Static source shows selection interaction, not a complete navigation/form/dialog simulator.
The existing preview banner explicitly says communication only and product_pass=false; preserve that evidence boundary.

M02 read-lease/verified byte-snapshot consumer contract is adopted for future publication integration, but S2-S4 are not implemented. M03 cannot claim the current preview consumes verified new generation.

findings.issue: No frozen metadata compatibility contract covers JS guides and future interactions through HOST serialization.
findings.next: Enumerate authoritative fields and extension policy before codec changes; test full semantic roundtrip.

findings.issue: Editor selection, Viewer mock actions and real privileged commands need separate event authority.
findings.next: Freeze allowlisted interaction schema and isolated state/event bridge; preview cannot invent filesystem/dispatch privileges.

findings.issue: No exact stable-ID cross-location, revision rejection and unsupported-capability result matrix.
findings.next: Define explicit unresolved/stale/unsupported outcomes and UI states before Skeleton.

architecture_proposal.hexagonal: Editor/Viewer driving adapters -> approved commands -> HOST use case -> WORK immutable design/binding projections; HOST -> approved document/asset/verified-generation abstractions <- codecs/native adapters.
architecture_proposal.dependencies: M01 selected target + document owner + M02 verified generated snapshot + M05 material availability -> M03 projected Editor/Viewer state. M04/M07 observe content commits only, not ephemeral preview changes.
architecture_proposal.ownership: Document owner remains authoritative. Editor draft, selection and isolated mock Viewer state are explicit separate lifecycle projections, never writable mirrors of other documents.
architecture_proposal.mutation: Editor content edits use declared application mutation boundary. Selection/cross-location is view-only. Viewer uses mock-only allowlist and cannot call arbitrary dispatch commands.
architecture_proposal.transaction: Load/validate/bind immutable design revision -> build temporary preview projection -> replace Viewer projection only on success. Failure retains previous verified projection with stale label. No preview process writes source state.
forbidden: file URL bypass of verified generation
Executing imported code as preview behavior
Replacing real document with preview mock state

UI_schema_proposal.role: local project author without programming/Git prerequisite
UI_schema_proposal.defaults: Editor is safe selection/edit mode; Viewer must be explicitly entered for mock interaction. Exact persisted mode default remains proposed.
UI_schema_proposal.disabled: Cross-locate disabled when mapping unresolved/ambiguous. Dependent mock action disabled if required capability/material missing. Refresh unavailable while source binding invalid.
UI_schema_proposal.errors: Report stale revision, unsupported action, invalid preview or missing material without claiming success.
UI_schema_proposal.empty: Explain no controls/no verified preview and provide only meaningful approved actions.
UI_schema_proposal.accessibility: Visible focus, keyboard-accessible mode/actions, announced status/error, no color-only capability distinction.
